All values come from this fictional simulation. On-time rate combines completed deliveries and live ETA forecasts. Delivery time includes preparation, pickup and the rider’s route. Cost combines distance shared by batched orders and idle rider reserve. The opening includes 50 simulated past deliveries to establish a baseline; your results count new deliveries only.
